ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008, arts. 4 and 5 (SAS formation); Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, arts. 353 and 354 (mercantile registry); Ley 2010 de 2019, art. 84, and Estatuto Tributario art. 631-7 (UBO reporting); Resolución DIAN 114 de 2020 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF); Ley 526 de 1999 and Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT framework and UIAF); Circular Básica Jurídica of the Superintendencia Financiera; Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular 221-000001 de 2020 (SAGRILAFT); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (mercantile registration).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction (e.g., Registrar of Companies)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille from competent foreign affairs authority; if the origin country is not a party to the Hague Convention, Colombian Consular Legalization (cadena consular)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the biographical page of the passport of each ultimate beneficial owner and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority in the country of origin; notarized by a local notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian Consular Legalization, plus sworn Spanish translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution of the foreign shareholder approving the incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S. and appointing its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or general meeting of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted to Colombian counsel for incorporation, registration and tax filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or source-of-funds certificate for each contributing shareholder

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 5, 9, 17-26; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), arts. 110, 124, 126; Decreto 1074 de 2015, arts. 2.2.2.1.1-2.2.2.43.2 (RUES); Ley 222 de 1995 (Superintendencia de Sociedades).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); supervisión societaria by Superintendencia de Sociedades de Colombia; tax registration by DIAN.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument with notarized or electronically signed bylaws) registered in the Registro Mercantil; a public deed (escritura pública) is mandatory only if real property is contributed to the company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; capital is freely set in the bylaws and may be zero at formation. Payment of subscribed capital is fixed in the bylaws and the unpaid balance must be fully paid within 2 years from the date of incorporation. No escrow account or bank deposit certificate is required to register the S.A.S.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1. The incorporation of the Company as a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada pursuant to Ley 1258 de 2008 is hereby ratified, and the subscription of the authorized share capital, as set forth in the bylaws, is approved. 2. The registered office is fixed at [Principal Address], Bogotá D.C., Colombia. 3. [Full Name] is appointed Gerente and legal representative, with full statutory and bylaw powers; [Full Name] is appointed alternate Gerente. 4. The legal representative is expressly authorized to complete the commercial registration before the Cámara de Comercio, obtain the NIT and electronic signature before DIAN, and open corporate bank accounts. 5. All ancillary documents are ratified and delegated to the legal representative, who shall execute all filings necessary to fulfill this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft, execute and authenticate the private incorporation instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — Constitución Empresarial en Línea (RUES portal) or any notary public for signature legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws compliant with Ley 1258/2008 including corporate name ending in S.A.S., registered office, share classes, capital payment terms, and administration powers. Have each incorporator sign before a notary or with the chamber-issued electronic signature, or use the online portal to upload the instrument. Attach the Pre-RUT, declare the beneficial owner (Declaración de Beneficiario Final), and select the activity code ISIC 4690 / NAICS 425120. No capital deposit is required at this stage.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución (bylaws) with notarized or digitally signed signatures
Valid cédula de ciudadanía or foreign passport of each incorporator
Pre-RUT (Pre-Registro Único Tributario) issued by DIAN
Declaración de Beneficiario Final (UBO declaration)
RUEA form (Registro Único Empresarial) available on the RUES platform
Zoning certificate (uso de suelo) for the registered office if requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry officer issues an observation (requerimiento), correct and resubmit the instrument and the required dossiers within 30 calendar days of the notice. Errors are cured by a separate aclaración document without re-executing signature pages; unresolved observations may be appealed to the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the instrument and pay registration fees (inscripción en el Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá — RUES registry window or online PSE payment portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed original instrument in triplicate together with the Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil and Pre-RUT. Pay the derechos de inscripción and the RUES fee (approx. USD 60 aggregate). Obtain the assigned Matrícula Mercantil and the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. The S.A.S. acquires legal personality as of this registration date.
required_dossiers: Signed original of the incorporation instrument
Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil with ISIC 4690 / NAICS 425120 declaration
Payment receipt (PSE / bank draft)
Pre-RUT confirmation with provisional NIT
Consent forms for the commercial registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is denied under Código de Comercio art. 112, cure the formal defect within the granted term (generally 10-20 working days) or file an appeal for reconsideration with the Chamber; judicial recourse lies with the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive tax registration and activation of electronic invoicing (NIT, RUT and firma electrónica)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — MUISCA online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into MUISCA with the provisional NIT assigned to the pre-RUT; complete the definitive RUT, adding the main economic activity 4690 and secondary codes (e.g., 8299 for back-office services). Activate the electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) regime, request the certification of the electronic signature through an DIAN-approved certificate authority, and register the legal representative as the company's responsible party.
required_dossiers: Pre-RUT / provisional NIT
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Identity document of the legal representative
Formulario Único Tributario (RUT update) via MUISCA
Request for activation of electronic invoicing (Resolución 000165 de 2023 framework)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT update or imposes a sanction for late filing, submit a subsanación (voluntary correction) with the corresponding payment and respond within the term of the auto; appeal by recurso de reconsideración within 5 working days after notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complementary registrations: legalization of corporate books, UBO declaration and AML/SAGRILAFT compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (libros de comercio); DIAN (Beneficiario Final); UIAF (supervision of SAGRILAFT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of registration, present the corporate books (Libro de Actas, Libro de Registro de Accionistas) to the Chamber for stamping. Update the Beneficiario Final declaration through RUES according to DIAN Resolution 164 de 2023. Given the medium-risk AML tier for re-invoicing transactions, adopt the SAGRILAFT manual under Circular Externa 004 de 2022 and register the compliance officer with UIAF if the transaction threshold (approx. 1,600 UVT monthly) is reached.
required_dossiers: Libros de comercio (actas, accionistas, registros)
Updated RUT with final NIT
Formulario de actualización del Beneficiario Final
SAGRILAFT manual and risk matrix
Identification document of the compliance officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late legalization of books is cured by paying the re-tariff fee to the Chamber; incorrect UBO filings are corrected spontaneously through RUES before DIAN inspection. SAGRILAFT gaps can be cured by adopting a corrective compliance plan prior to a UIAF visit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate bank accounts and administrative/operational activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks (Bancolombia, Davivienda, Scotiabank Colpatria) and municipal authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued within the last 90 days, the RUT, and the legal representative's ID to open a corporate current account supporting SWIFT LC, TT wire and XT transfer payment rails. Complete the bank's KYB/UBO diligence file, provide proof of the registered office address, and enroll the personnel with the ARL (occupational risk administrator) while filing the SG-SST program. No sectoral statutory license is required for pure re-invoicing under ISIC 4690.
required_dossiers: Certificado de existencia y representación legal (≤ 90 days)
RUT with final NIT
Proof of registered office address (utility bill / lease)
Bank KYB/UBO questionnaire and source-of-funds statement
ARL affiliation form and SG-SST program registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises KYB objections, resubmit an updated corporate certificate, the board resolution approving the account, and the SAGRILAFT/UBO file; in case of refusal, approach a second-tier bank or licensed fintech PSP with a medium-risk compliance presentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (MinCIT) — Dirección de Regulación; for foreign trade operations DIAN and Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCE) coordinate registrations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating or manufacturing license is required for re-invoicing and trade intermediation under ISIC 4690. Mandatory registrations are the Matrícula Mercantil, the RUT/NIT before DIAN, and, if physical cross-border movements are executed, the Registro de Usuario de Comercio Exterior at DIAN/VUCE.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente for municipal operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category IV) — office-based, non-industrial trade intermediation generating no process discharges, effluents or land alteration; an environmental viability brief is required only if the registered office includes a shared warehouse in a mixed-use building.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office domestic wastewater is conveyed to municipal sewer; direct discharge thresholds under Resolución 631 de 2015 (pH 6.0–9.0; BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L; TSS ≤ 300 mg/L) apply only for private treatment or industrial outfalls. No VOC point sources from re-invoicing; if an attached warehouse emits solvent vapors, Resolución 909 de 2008 (as amended) applies. Hazardous waste must be handled under Decreto 4741 de 2005 with manifests filed through the VITAL environmental window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bogotá: fire-safety certification for the office and warehouse areas (extinguishers, evacuation signage, emergency plan); structural load inspection of rented warehouses under Ley 400 de 1997 / NSR-10; ARL affiliation and SG-SST program under Decreto 1072 de 2015, with COPASST constituted when the workforce is 10 or more employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — official portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic filing and registration platform: MUISCA/DIAN Transaccional
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An S.A.S. is incorporated by private document registered with the Cámara de Comercio, which assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) as the statutory TIN. The legal representative must then register or update the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) with DIAN in advance of the first taxable transaction, selecting the VAT responsibility code for export-oriented supplies. If the direct or indirect foreign shareholder is a non-resident entity, it must appoint a Colombian resident attorney-in-fact and provide proof of foreign tax residence or incorporation documents when requested by DIAN. No separate VAT identification number exists for the S.A.S.; the NIT/RUT combination serves as TIN and VAT ID. The S.A.S. must also obtain an electronic signature and an invoicing resolution from DIAN before issuing electronic invoices.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist under Colombian law; the S.A.S. is per se an entity-level income tax and VAT taxpayer. Only micro and small taxpayers meeting the statutory gross-income test may elect the Régimen SIMPLE de Tributación under Articles 903–916 of the Colombian Tax Statute, subject to activity eligibility and the 100,000 UVT annual gross-income cap. Re-invoicing intermediation operations are presumed to remain under the ordinary entity-level tax regime unless SIMPLE eligibility is expressly confirmed with DIAN.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre las Ventas, IVA) — Colombian national value added tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis turnover threshold applies: VAT registration is mandatory from the first taxable supply or import performed in Colombian territory (COP 0 threshold). For optional SIMPLE-regime eligibility, annual gross income must not exceed 100,000 UVT (approximately COP 4.7 billion for tax year 2025).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All Colombian merchants, including S.A.S. re-invoicing hubs, must issue electronic sales invoices (factura electrónica de venta) in XML format through authorized technology providers or DIAN's free web platform. Each invoice must be transmitted to DIAN in real time, validated against the authorized numbering range issued by DIAN resolution, and carry the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) as the mandatory cryptographic digital stamp. Subsequent lifecycle events (acknowledgment, rejection, debit/credit notes) must be exchanged through DIAN web services/APIs. An invoice without DIAN validation and CUFE is not legally valid for VAT credit, deductible cost, or export zero-rating support.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for the 0% rate when they are physically exported from Colombian customs territory under an accepted export customs declaration, sold to a non-resident buyer, and paid in foreign currency through the Colombian foreign exchange market. Services, including software development, IT consultancy, digital services, and offshore commercial re-invoicing support, qualify when rendered to a non-resident without Colombian domicile, economically used or exploited entirely outside Colombia, and not linked to Colombian real estate or tangible property located in Colombia. The 0% rate is claimed in the periodic VAT return (Formulario 300) and the export invoice must expressly indicate 'Exportación' and tariff code; supporting contracts, export declarations, delivery evidence, and FX repatriation records must be retained for inspection.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) accepted by DIAN
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or equivalent transport document evidencing physical departure from Colombian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate, SWIFT MT103, or Colombian bank certificate proving foreign-currency repatriation within the permitted term
Commercial invoice and underlying export or re-invoicing contract
Packing list and, if applicable, certificate of origin
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit the full export substantiation file and require proof of shipment, service performance, contract, invoicing, and foreign-currency collection within the 180-day repatriation term. If zero-rating is unsupported or documents are false, DIAN will assess 19% VAT on the gross transaction, charge monthly default interest, and impose the 20% penalty for undue VAT refunds or compensations under Article 670 of the Colombian Tax Statute. A higher inexactitude penalty of up to 100% of the resulting tax difference may apply under Article 647 where the VAT return contains false or inaccurate information. Fraudulent export zero-rating may also trigger criminal tax evasion proceedings under Article 434A of the Tax Statute, and the DIAN clawback period generally covers the prior five tax years, extendable in cases of criminal fraud, concealment, or omissive conduct.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (Financial Superintendency of Colombia) as the bank conduct supervisor and DIAN as the customs and foreign-exchange enforcement agency. The regulatory backbone is Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso is freely convertible under the free foreign-exchange market. Current-account transactions, including trade-related receipts and payments, do not require prior central bank approval; they must be executed through authorized intermediaries and supported by the relevant declaration of exchange. Capital-account operations such as foreign direct investment, portfolio investment, and foreign loans require registration with Banco de la República but are not subject to a concession or prior license regime. Profit remittances are legally permitted without exchange surrender, provided the foreign investment is duly registered, distributable reserves are evidenced by audited financial statements, and Colombian dividend withholding and income-tax obligations are satisfied. The practical hurdles for a re-invoicing S.A.S. are documentary rather than exchange-control-based: each inward and outward flow must bear a precise economic concept, be booked through a supervised bank, and be reconcilable with the tax and customs filings of the Colombian entity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia no longer imposes compulsory surrender of export proceeds to the central bank; the mandatory conversion ratio is zero percent, and exporters may keep and use foreign currency subject to channelization rules. The fundamental obligation is to canalize export earnings through an authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary as soon as they are received, and within the maximum statutory intervals established by Banco de la República regulatory practice: for goods generally the earlier of the commercial payment term or a period of up to 13 months from the date of shipment where genuine supplier credit exists, and for services generally up to four months from the contractual maturity date, with extensions permitted only for registered external credit. The exporter must present the DIAN export declaration, the collection proof, and the relevant foreign-exchange declaration; failure to meet the deadline triggers exchange-infraction proceedings and monetary fines.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational COP current account / capital-contribution escrow / USD foreign-currency account
Operational current account / trade-finance subfacility / foreign-currency settlement account
Operational current account / USD account / documentary LC issuing line
Operational account / hedging and derivatives account / multicurrency deposit account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-Medium for purely offshore digital EMIs. Foreign e-money institutions are not licensed Colombian banks and cannot open onshore current accounts, access the local clearing systems operated under Banco de la República, or submit declarations of exchange. Under Colombian law, an entity that seeks to provide payment accounts in Colombia must be authorized by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia as an electronic payment corporation (SEDPE/PES). For a re-invoicing S.A.S., an offshore EMI is therefore only a supplementary outbound execution rail where the actual regulated account remains at a tier-one Colombian bank; every transaction must still be captured in the official FX market and accompanied by the corresponding invoice and purpose code. Attempting to use an unlicensed EMI as the primary Colombian treasury channel would violate the channelization rules and create AML and exchange-control exposure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a foreign-owned S.A.S. with an enhanced medium-risk profile, the onboarding process requires at least one physical identification and KYC interview, either at the selected bank branch or through an approved supervised virtual biometric process, attended by a director, principal beneficial owner, or a local attorney-in-fact acting under notarized and apostilled power of attorney with certified Spanish translation. Pure remote opening is generally unavailable until after the initial interview is completed. Banks will also require the chamber-of-commerce corporate certificate, legal-beneficiary declarations, board minutes appointing signatories, and proof of ultimate beneficial ownership throughout the group. The practical recommendation is a single in-country visit by the treasury manager or the execution of a broad corporate power of attorney in favor of a resident authorized officer or professional accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Borderless re-invoicing company with non-resident shareholders and no visible operational substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Chamber-of-commerce certificate; shareholder registry and group organisational chart; board resolution approving re-invoicing activity; master supply agreement and master sales agreement; third-party logistics contracts or delivery orders; office lease agreement; outsourced accounting and tax engagement letters; projected cash-flow model and evidence of actual trade transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through transaction pattern with rapid credits and debits to unrelated parties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction-level reconciliation file matching purchase orders to sales invoices; board-approved treasury policy; invoice settlement calendar; counterparty KYC profiles; payment authorisation matrix; transport evidence such as bills of lading, airway bills, and container tracking; margin analysis showing that each trade generates operating income.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exposure to high-risk jurisdictions, shell-company counterparties, or PEP-linked owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and PEP screening snapshots for every counterparty and ultimate beneficial owner; FATF country assessments; legal opinion regarding permissibility of trade with the jurisdiction; registration and good-standing certificates; internal policies on prohibitions and enhanced due diligence; transaction monitoring log submitted to the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Turnover materially disproportionate to registered capital and financial statements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder contribution documents and bank-in-history; audited financial statements of parent or group; intercompany financing agreements; registered external credit declaration where applicable; confirmed letters of credit; working-capital forecast; transfer-pricing documentation showing the S.A.S. earns a clear arm's-length margin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of offshore payment service providers or non-bank FX platforms
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Licence and registration evidence of the payment service provider; bank-approved fintech due-diligence questionnaire; transaction chain records showing the Colombian bank as the entry and exit point; legal rationale for using the provider; annual attestation that no Colombian-resident transaction has bypassed official FX market reporting.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound routing for a capital contribution to the Colombian S.A.S. consists of: (1) registration of the foreign direct investment with Banco de la República using the applicable foreign-investment registration form, processed through the receiving Colombian bank; (2) issuance of an incoming remittance instruction from the non-resident shareholder using SWIFT MT103 with the S.A.S.'s precise registered name, the locally issued foreign-currency or COP account number, the bank BIC, and the economic concept described as direct investment capital contribution; (3) validation by the bank of the underlying shareholder resolution and apostilled corporate documentation; and (4) issuance of the local certificate of exchange, evidencing the conversion and the official statistical classification. The certificate is retained for the DIAN audit file and reconciled against the equity roll-forward in the statutory financial statements. If the contribution is made instead as an intercompany loan, the maturity, interest rate, and amortization schedule must be reviewed for external-credit registration when the term exceeds twelve months; short-term trade credit must nevertheless be itemised in the relevant exchange declaration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements should use two principal rails: SWIFT MT103/MT202 wire transfers and documentary letters of credit issued under UCP600. For ordinary supplier payments, the S.A.S. instructs its Colombian bank to remit funds via MT103 with invoice, purchase-order, and LC references; the bank will pre-validate the underlying commercial documents and assign an approved foreign-exchange concept, usually linked to a prior import declaration or goods import program. For larger or formalised purchases, the S.A.S. opens an irrevocable commercial LC through the tier-one bank, with settlement at sight or deferred tenor in USD, EUR, or invoice currency. All disbursements must be archived together with the bank's exchange settlement receipt and be traceable to the shipment or service documentation. The use of local ACH rails inside Colombia is limited to domestic operating expenses; cross-border clearing must remain on correspondent-banking channels. If Colombian customs or tariff reasons require payment of import duties, those duties are settled separately through the bank using the DIAN single-tax window, never through an offshore EMI.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/COP outright forward contracts with registered Colombian banks
USD/COP non-deliverable forwards executed onshore through an authorized intermediary or offshore using a Colombian bank's London/New York branch window
Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps for intercompany loan servicing and trade-cycle liquidity matching
USD/COP put-and-call options and range-forward structures offered by regulated local financial institutions

Commodity-price hedging instruments where the underlying re-invoiced goods are physically traded commodities, restricted to strictly hedged non-speculative positions and governed by ISDA credit-support arrangements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual commercial registration renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31, covering the company's status as of December 31 of the preceding year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a graduated monetary surcharge calculated on the unpaid renewal fee and declared assets; after three months the registration is marked 'no renovada,' the Chamber blocks issuance of existence certificates and legalization of books, and continued delinquency may result in cancellation of the mercantile registration and administrative strike-off of the SAS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración y Actualización Anual del Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Once per calendar year during the DIAN-assigned income tax return window, typically mid-August through late October; an updated declaration is also required whenever ownership changes occur.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or materially inaccurate data exposes the legal representative to DIAN penalties under E.T. Article 651 of up to 15,000 UVT per report; persistent non-compliance may suspend electronic invoicing privileges and impede export or customs-related operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Aprobación de Estados Financieros Anuales y Acta de Asamblea de Accionistas (annual financial statement approval)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate act recorded in the Libro de Actas; no direct government filing, but the approved accounts ground the annual Chamner renewal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after fiscal year-end; financial statements cut off on December 31 must be approved by the shareholders by March 31 of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve within one year invalidates the financial statements for legal purposes, blocks the March 31 commercial renewal, and may expose administrators to shareholder liability actions; no direct fine is assessed by the Chamber, but the company loses access to official certificates until regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Form 110 corporate income tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between mid-August and late October per DIAN's official calendar, with the exact date assigned based on the last digit of the company's NIT; applies to the preceding calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a monthly extemporaneity penalty of up to 5% of the tax due per month or fraction thereof (capped at 100%), plus default interest; continued non-filing can trigger DIAN official assessment, seizure of bank accounts, and suspension of the RUT, but does not directly cause corporate strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A mandatory independent auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is required if the SAS has total assets exceeding 5,000 minimum monthly wages (SMMLV), gross ordinary income exceeding 3,000 SMMLV, or more than 200 employees at year-end, or if the company is subject to government inspection or control; below these thresholds the shareholders may voluntarily appoint a revisor fiscal or independent auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian GAAP aligned with IFRS under Decreto 2420 of 2015 and subsequent amendments: Group 1 applies full IFRS; Group 2 applies NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs); Group 3 applies the simplified micro-entity framework; large and public-interest companies must apply full IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must file the annual RUB declaration through DIAN's electronic portal; the declaration must identify any direct or indirect individual shareholder holding at least 5% of capital or voting rights, and any individual exercising effective control; every transfer of shares during the preceding year must be reflected in the shareholders' register and certified in the updated RUB statement, with supporting corporate records retained for inspection.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders' Assembly (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Minute Book of Board of Directors (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva, when a board exists)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 – 2,500 per year for the contractual registered office, legal representation, and corporate agency package
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 – 14,000 per year for a certified independent audit where required or voluntarily engaged

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for general re-invoicing traders; CIT at 35% with possible 0% 'renta presuntiva'... CHC holding regime: 20%? Hmm. I'll mention: 'Régimen de Compañías Holding Colombianas (CHC)' can bring foreign-dividend and capital-gain exemptions if entity qualifies; standard re-invoicing margin is taxed in full at 35%; VAT on commissions? For ISIC 4690: VAT (IVA) is imposed at 19% on commissions/services rendered in Colombia; export trade/rezxport to non-resident customers may be zero-rated.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_note: For losses generated from taxable year 2017 onwards, Colombian law allows indefinite carryforward; however, the annual offset is capped at 25% of net taxable income. Pre-2017 losses must be used within five years. The schema's legacy field is set to 5 and is conservative.
